methods.ctrime: CRIME compression oracle: zlib(pt+FLAG), (guess+c)*5 query-length minimization byte-at-a-time, cross-checked at *3; ~2k queries.
methods.stream_consciousness: Counter.new(128) fixed-key CTR => same keystream every request; many-time-pad via printable-ASCII intersection + English letter-frequency scoring over 160 samples; 19 distinct lines all decrypted to clean text, flag line 32 bytes.
methods.paper_plane: IGE padding oracle: single-block truncation keeps intermediate D(C_k^m0) fixed while c0 XOR-out is attacker-controlled => CBC-style byte-at-a-time on c0; m0 = m0_orig for block1 else recovered P_{k-1}; ~3.3k queries, 2 blocks.
methods.forbidden_fruit: GCM fixed-nonce key recovery (cryptopals 63): two 1-block known plaintexts give Tdiff = Cdiff*H^2 => H^2 via field inverse, H = unique sqrt; S = Tag xor GHASH; validated on other lengths; forged 1-block ct decrypting to 'give me the flag' under server IV -> server returned FLAG.
methods.logon-zero: ZeroLogon/CVE-2020-1472 CFB8: token = single repeated byte keeps cipher state constant so every decrypted byte equals v=E_K(pad*16)[0]^pad; when v==0 password length (last 4 bytes) is 0 => empty password; sweep pads 0..255 per key, reset_connection for new keys; authenticated with empty password.
methods.pad_thai: Honest CBC padding oracle on ct=(iv||2 blocks of hex-string message); byte-at-a-time recovery of D(C2) then D(C1) with hex-charset candidates shifted by true prev block, random-filler survivor disambiguation; submitted recovered message -> flag.
methods.good_pad_ugly: Noisy pad_thai (result = good OR 60% coin): False is definitive; re-query all True survivors per byte until single survivor with 22 consecutive Trues; 1961/12000 queries, no backoff needed.

notes: socket.cryptohack.org:13421/13422 protocol: plain-text greeting LINE first, then newline-delimited JSON (options: encrypt/unpad/check); greeting must be consumed by line, not by waiting for '{'.

GCM GHASH pitfall: multiplicative identity of the GCM bit-reflected ring is 1<<127, so an inverse accumulator must not be seeded with integer 1; a gmul(X,ginv(X))==1 self-test cancels the x^127 error and hides the bug.
stream_consciousness flag uses 'Crypto{' (capital C) - regex on 'crypto{' only will miss it.
paper_plane send_msg oracle: uncaught ValueError for pad_len>16 returns non-JSON; treat any non-'Message received' as invalid.
